title: S&P 500 opens higher as Nvidia rallies on AI infrastructure deal
excerpt: Oil prices steadied after Brent crude pulled back from $90, as reports of progress in Middle East peace talks eased pressure on markets
content_html:
Cris Tolomia

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 6:48 AM PDT 2 min read

U.S. stocks opened higher Tuesday, with Nvidia stock leading gains as investors weighed mixed signals on the Middle East conflict and awaited a key inflation report due Wednesday.

The S&P 500 rose 0.1% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 126 points, or 0.2%, while the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.1%. Nvidia stock gained more than 1%, providing critical support to the S&P 500 after the company announced Monday a partnership with six major asset managers aimed at channeling over $500 billion into artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Oil prices swung earlier in the session before stabilizing. Brent crude futures touched $90 a barrel in early trading as hopes for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz faded following new demands from both Iran and President Trump, according to The Wall Street Journal. Oil pulled back after Bloomberg quoted Pakistan Defense Minister Khawaja Asif as saying Washington and Tehran were close to an agreement, while separately a Qatari foreign ministry official indicated that Oman and Iran were engaged in substantive discussions about strait navigation rights. Brent crude was last trading around $87 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures were at $81 a barrel.

Iran said it is closing in on a deal with Oman to reopen the strait, but has continued to resist direct negotiations with the U.S. Abbas Araghchi, Iran's foreign minister, stated Sunday that talks could not resume while Washington remains in breach of the June memorandum of understanding and has yet to provide compensation for those breaches, the semi-official Tasnim News Agency reported.

The calming of oil markets helped pull government bond yields back down from their earlier advance. At one point during Tuesday's session, yields on the 10-year and 30-year Treasuries had climbed toward levels last seen at their 2026 closing peaks, according to the Journal. The 10-year yield later fell to 4.672%.

Overseas, South Korea's Kospi closed 0.73% higher and Australia's S&P/ASX 200 added 0.19%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 1.03% and mainland China's CSI 300 dropped 0.79%. European indexes including the FTSE 100, CAC 40 and DAX all traded below the flatline.

Attention now shifts to the July consumer price index, set for release Wednesday, with the producer price index to follow on Thursday.

content_html_zh:
克里斯·托洛米亚

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 11 日星期二上午 6:48 阅读时间 2 分钟

美国股市周二高开，英伟达股价领涨，因投资者权衡中东冲突的复杂信号，并等待周三发布的关键通胀报告。

标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.1%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 126 点，即 0.2%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 0.1%。 英伟达周一宣布与六家主要资产管理公司建立合作伙伴关系，旨在向人工智能基础设施投入超过 5000 亿美元，该公司股价上涨超过 1%，为标准普尔 500 指数提供了关键支撑。

油价早盘震荡，随后企稳。 据《华尔街日报》报道，由于伊朗和特朗普总统提出新要求，重新开放霍尔木兹海峡达成协议的希望逐渐减弱，布伦特原油期货早盘触及每桶 90 美元。 彭博社援引巴基斯坦国防部长卡瓦贾·阿西夫的话说华盛顿和德黑兰接近达成协议，而卡塔尔外交部官员分别表示阿曼和伊朗正在就海峡航行权进行实质性讨论，油价回落。 布伦特原油最新交易价格约为每桶 87 美元，而美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货价格为每桶 81 美元。

据半官方的塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，伊朗表示即将与阿曼达成重新开放海峡的协议，但仍继续抵制与美国的直接谈判。伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇周日表示，由于华盛顿仍然违反了六月份的谅解备忘录，并且尚未为这些违规行为提供赔偿，因此无法恢复谈判。

石油市场的平静帮助政府债券收益率从先前的涨幅回落。 据《华尔街日报》报道，周二交易时段，10 年期和 30 年期国债收益率一度攀升至 2026 年收盘高点的水平。 10年期国债收益率随后跌至4.672%。

海外方面，韩国 Kospi 指数收盘上涨 0.73%，澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数上涨 0.19%。 香港恒生指数下跌1.03%，中国内地沪深300指数下跌0.79%。 包括 FTSE 100、CAC 40 和 DAX 在内的欧洲指数均低于平盘线。

现在的注意力转向定于周三发布的 7 月份消费者价格指数，周四将发布生产者价格指数。
